excerpt.zh: 我们收到了来自[From.GetName]的通讯！他们似乎已经成功翻译了我们的语言。双方之间的外交频道已经打开，一切敌对行为已经暂时停止。
excerpt.en: We are receiving a transmission from the [From.GetName]! They appear to have successfully translated our language. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities between us have ceased for the moment.

texts.zh: 我们收到了来自[From.GetName]的通讯！他们似乎已经成功翻译了我们的语言。双方之间的外交频道已经打开，一切敌对行为已经暂时停止。
texts.en: We are receiving a transmission from the [From.GetName]! They appear to have successfully translated our language. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities between us have ceased for the moment.

texts.zh: 我们收到了来自[From.GetName]的通讯！他们似乎已经成功翻译了我们的语言。随着他们开放了交流频道，我们可以将他们认定为曾被我们抛弃的难民。双方的一切敌对行为已经暂时停止。
texts.en: We are receiving a transmission from the [From.GetName]! They appear to have successfully translated our language. As they open channels, we can recognize them as the refugees we once abandoned. Hostilities between us have ceased for the moment.
